decisions.label: Colour pool strength
decisions.note: Adds the mushroom's own colour on dark ground.

decisions.label: Complement colour amount
decisions.note: How much complementary colour is removed; zero leaves only the additive pool.

decisions.label: Halo height
decisions.note: Multiplies the flat halo's small lift off the ground (0.04 m at 1).

decisions.label: Cap spot glow
decisions.note: Brightness of the cap's marked spots and their spill.

decisions.label: Mushroom test row
decisions.note: One of each colour, 10 m apart, near 40 m south of the dancefloor. The whole row moves together if blocked. Pickable; collected samples stay collected until a new night.
